text:
maria_csm: Heads-up — Aerolith just told me they're rolling webhooks to ops + search team adoption next sprint. They want embeddings for semantic search + a webhook fan-out so expect ~3x request rate. pinging eng for capacity thoughts.

sam_cs: Nice. Is this across their entire org or limited teams?

maria_csm: Starts w/ 2 teams (ops, search). Current baseline ~15k req/day, they expect ~45k/day within 6 weeks. Embedding vector dim ~1536, batched. They also asked for realtime webhook fan-out (sync) with 200 qps bursts.

teo_eng: 200 qps bursts + embeddings = heavy. If they want <200ms search latency we'll need GPU-backed workers and prefix caching. Two options: Dedicated pool or hosted + managed burst.

emma_se: We can mitigate with batching + prefix KV cache. Suggested model family: embed-1536-quant or an open 1536 dim if customer prefers OSS. Recommend async webhook fan-out with callback to avoid blocking.

deploy-bot: alert: aerolith-prod usage growth detected (https://console.redwood/investigate/aerolith) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sam_cs: Any signal on renewal? This looks like an upsell opportunity but we should confirm their contract timeline.

maria_csm: Renewal in ~3 months. Health score 85 but ops team lacks internal docs. I'll propose a focused onboarding workshop + trial Dedicated for 30d to prove throughput/cost.

teo_eng: For sizing I'll need traces: query length distribution, embedding batch sizes, and peak qps windows. I'll draft two configs (Dedicated vs Hosted-burst) with cost delta.

emma_se: Quick config snippet we can share with them (send as example in enablement):
```
route: /webhook/search
model: embed-1536-quant
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  max_batch_time_ms: 25
cache:
  prefix: true
rate_limit: 500rps
```

maria_csm: Great. I'll set a 1-hr enablement next Tue and invite ops+search leads. Sam — can you prepare an ROI calc + recommended commitment tiers for the renewal/upsell?

sam_cs: On it. I'll draft ROI + cost delta and attach by EOD Friday.

teo_eng: I'll bring a small load-test harness and a telemetry snippet (how to capture KV cache hit rates and p50/p95 token latencies). Also will list recommended quantized model variants.

maria_csm: Next steps: workshop invite, telemetry sample, POC Dedicated 30d quote. Keeping renewal green but marking as expansion opportunity. :white_check_mark:
